description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2022: NHERI Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel Experimental Facility is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jennifer Bridge, University of Florida (ufl.edu). This poster describes the experimental resources and user services provided by the NHERI Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel (BLWT) Experimental Facility (EF) at the University of Florida. The EF provides users access to wind engineering experimental resources to accelerate research discovery in wind hazard characterization and mitigation. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-q8eb-p058. Keywords: Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel Experimental Facility, Powell Laboratory. Published 2023-02-24. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
